attributes.board_name: Iowa Board of Pharmacy (Department of Inspections, Appeals, and Licensing)

rules.alternatives: Registration requires current and active national pharmacy technician certification (e.g. PTCB) and expires when that certification expires; recertification CE is set by the certifying body, not by Iowa.
rules.notes: Registration renews without a state CE requirement. Since July 16, 2025 the technician rule is 481—551.7: the fee is $20 per year and the registration expires on the date the national certification expires; the CE rule in the same chapter (551.4) applies to pharmacists only. Technician trainees (no national certification) register for one year, with at most one renewal.
rules.rule_quote: 551.7(2) Certified pharmacy technician. An individual who holds current and active national pharmacy technician certification will register as a technician. The registration fee is $20 per annum, and the registration will expire on the date that the technician’s national certification expires.
